WITH warning_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_errors (job_id, severity, error_code, error_message, recoverable, context)
  SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, 'warning', 'GENERATION_PARSE_WARNING', COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.warning_message_sql}}',''),'LLM response parse warning'), true, jsonb_build_object('raw_text', LEFT('{{$json.raw_model_text_sql}}', 2000), 'workflow', '{{$json.current_stage_sql}}')
  WHERE COALESCE('{{$json.parse_warning}}','false') = 'true'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id, '{{$json.output_type_sql}}' AS output_type_sql, '{{$json.dispatch_label_sql}}' AS dispatch_label_sql, '{{$json.generated_output_json_sql}}' AS generated_output_json_sql;
